_about: Curated sample corpus from the UCSF Industry Documents Library (Opioid Industry Documents Archive) used to build and test unified multimodal search. IDs are IDL document ids; metadata is fetched from the IDL Solr API at build time so this file stays small and auditable.

source.license: Public court records released through litigation; hosted by UCSF IDL. Check per-item availability before redistributing.

collection.name: Opioid Industry Documents Archive (sample)
collection.description: A 12-recording, 24-exhibit sample drawn from the Opioid Industry Documents Archive: videotaped Mallinckrodt executive depositions, sales voicemails, litigation documents, trial-exhibit charts, and photographs. Assembled as a multimodal search test base.

recordings._note: One part per deposition. Media is downloaded locally, uploaded to TheirStory by hand, transcribed there, then re-imported via `yarn theirstory:import-stories`. Audio ids are chosen from items that actually have a playable Internet Archive derivative — many IDL audio records list one that the Archive cannot serve.

exhibits._note: Ingested page-by-page: each page becomes one searchable object carrying a rendered page image plus its OCR text.
